tools.name: search_casting_calls
tools.title: Search Casting Calls
tools.description:
Search for publicly available casting calls on Backstage.

IMPORTANT EXTRACTION GUIDELINES:
- Do not make up any information - only extract what is explicitly mentioned in the query
- If a parameter is not mentioned, leave it as null/None
- Use natural language hints in parentheses to identify parameters (e.g., 'crew' → job_type='crew')
- Only apply filters when user explicitly mentions them (e.g., union status, gender, ethnicity)
- Use only the exact parameter names defined in the schema

READ-ONLY: This tool only retrieves public casting listings. Does not submit applications or modify any data.
NO SIDE EFFECTS: Safe to call for browsing opportunities.
PUBLIC DATA: Returns publicly visible job postings from Backstage.com casting database.

The LLM should provide location in "City, State" format along with latitude and longitude coordinates.
All codes (role_type, job_type, etc.) should be provided as single-letter/short codes, not natural language.

Examples:
    - For "Find lead actor roles in New York":
        location="New York, NY", latitude=40.7128, longitude=-74.0060, role_type=["L"], job_type="tal"

    - For "Union voiceover work in LA":
        location="Los Angeles, CA", latitude=34.0522, longitude=-118.2437, job_type="vo", union_status="U"

    - For "Grip roles in London":
        location="London, UK", latitude=51.5074, longitude=-0.1278, job_type="crew", role_type=["P"], query="Grip"

    - For "Director of Photography jobs in NYC":
        location="New York, NY", latitude=40.7128, longitude=-74.0060, job_type="crew", role_type=["P"], query="Director of Photography"

location.description: Location in "City, State" format. Examples: "New York, NY", "Los Angeles, CA"

radius.description: Search radius in miles when geo coordinates are provided

ethnicity.description: Ethnicity codes - ONLY if explicitly mentioned: 2=White, 3=Black, 4=Latino, 5=Asian, 6=South Asian, 7=Indigenous, 8=Middle Eastern, 9=Southeast Asian, 10=Multiracial

pt.description:
Production type filter IDs - Only apply if user is explicitly specifying project types.
Available parent categories:
- 112: Film (includes Feature Film, Short Film, Student Film, Documentary)
- 55: Theater (includes Play, Musical)
- 56: TV / Series (includes Scripted Show, Reality TV, Documentary Series)
- 59: Branded Content / Commercial (includes TV Commercial, Online Ad, Photography)
- 113: User Generated Content (includes Social Media Ad, Review/Testimonial, Unboxing)
- 63: Other Digital Media (includes Music Video, Animation, Video Game, Podcast)
- 62: More Projects (includes Gigs, Live Performing Arts, Events, Workshops)

role_type.description:
Role types - use 'C,D,L,M,N,S,T,X' for any acting roles. Only apply if user explicitly specifies role types.
- L: Lead/Star/Principal
- S: Supporting/Co-Star
- D: Day Player/Guest
- V: Voiceover ('vo', 'voice actor', 'voice work')
- C: Chorus/Ensemble
- P: Staff & Crew ('crew', 'production staff', 'behind the scenes')
- T: Content Creator/Influencer ('ugc', 'user generated content')
- M: Model ('model', 'modeling', 'fashion')
- R: Real People/Documentary ('real people', 'documentary', 'non-actor')

job_type.description:
Job type - Only apply if user explicitly mentions job types below. Otherwise leave it empty.
- tal: Talent/Acting ('actor', 'performer')
- vo: Voiceover ('vo', 'voice actor', 'voice work')
- crew: Production Crew ('crew', 'production staff', 'behind the scenes')
- ugc: UGC/Content Creator ('ugc', 'content creator', 'influencer')
- model: Modeling ('model', 'modeling', 'fashion')
- real: Real People/Documentary ('real people', 'documentary', 'non-actor')

union_status.description: Union status - ONLY if mentioned: U=Union only, N=Non-Union only, B=Both

min_age.description: Minimum age - only if explicitly mentioned

max_age.description: Maximum age - only if explicitly mentioned

compensation_type.description: Compensation - ONLY if mentioned: paid=Paid work, unpaid=Unpaid, any=Either

is_remote.description: Remote work - ONLY if mentioned: true=remote only, false=in-person only

sort_by.description: Sort order: approved=Latest, expires=Expiring soon, audition=Upcoming auditions, relevance=Most relevant

query.description:
Free-text search for show names, genres, or specific role/job titles.
IMPORTANT for crew searches: when job_type='crew' or role_type includes 'P', always populate query with the specific crew job title (e.g. 'Grip', 'Gaffer', 'Director of Photography', 'Sound Mixer', 'Production Assistant', 'Script Supervisor'). The crew job type filter alone is too broad — query is required to surface the right roles.

original_query.description: The original user query before extraction

tools.name: get_casting_call_details
tools.title: Get Casting Call Details
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific casting call.

READ-ONLY: This tool only retrieves public casting call details. Does not submit applications.
NO SIDE EFFECTS: Safe to call for viewing opportunity information.

Provide the casting_call_id to retrieve full details.

casting_call_id.description: Unique numeric ID of the casting call

tools.name: get_similar_casting_calls
tools.title: Get Similar Casting Calls
tools.description:
Get casting calls similar to a specific casting call.

READ-ONLY: This tool only retrieves similar public listings. Does not modify data.
NO SIDE EFFECTS: Safe to call for discovering related opportunities.

This is useful for finding related opportunities when a user is interested in a particular casting call.

casting_call_id.description: Unique numeric ID of the casting call to find similar ones for
